name: plan-cycle
about: Plans, scenario 8 (docs/phases/07-planning.md), at the loopd level: engineering's turn reports a blueprint whose pieces depend on each other in a cycle. loopd fails the turn with the cycle, adds no blueprint version and files nothing; the plan stays at blueprint, waiting on the user. A reply queues the next turn, whose good blueprint is kept.
